summary.text: Joan Hartley, a Democrat, has represented District 15 in the Connecticut State Senate since 2001 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She previously served in the Connecticut House of Representatives for District 73 from 1985 to 2000.
She earned a B.A. from Elms College and an M.A. from Trinity College, and her professional experience includes working as an educator.
